description: SOFR OIS curve data for Fixed-Income Derivatives trades #22-25 (10Y SOFR IRS, 5Yx10Y swaption, 2Yx5Y Bermudan swaption, 1Y SOFR cap). See docs/design/AITrade_quantlib_portfolio_marketdata.md §4.4.

notes: 4-year lookback from 2022-01-01 captures the 2022 rate-shock episode (MOVE ~160, critical for swaption vol calibration) and full post-LIBOR SOFR curve history.
Daily granularity preserved: the QL curve-bootstrap runs on daily snapshots; weekly sub-sampling happens in the stress-scenario layer.
DTCC SDR data is available only from 2023-12-29 — that source uses its own start_date_override.

nyfed_sofr.name: NY Fed SOFR Reference Rates
nyfed_sofr.description: SOFR overnight fixing + EFFR from NY Fed (authoritative source). Compounded averages and SOFR Index are sourced from FRED (fred_rates) which republishes the same NY Fed data. The sofr30day/sofr90day/sofr180day/sofrai NY Fed endpoints do not support the search.json pattern and return HTTP 400.

sofr_overnight.description: SOFR overnight rate — primary anchor for SOFR OIS curve bootstrap

effr.description: Effective Federal Funds Rate — policy rate upper bound

fred_rates.name: FRED Rate Series
fred_rates.description: UST par yields (DGS2/5/10/30) for curve anchoring + SOFR averages as cross-check. Uses fredgraph.csv endpoint (no API key, avoids /fred/series 504 on large FX series).

series.DGS1MO: 1M UST CMT par yield — front-end node (risk curve granularity, GAP 3)
series.DGS3MO: 3M UST CMT par yield — front-end node (GAP 3)
series.DGS6MO: 6M UST CMT par yield — front-end node (GAP 3)
series.DGS2: 2Y UST CMT par yield — short-end anchor for curve
series.DGS10: 10Y UST CMT par yield — primary duration hedge point (trade #22)
series.DGS30: 30Y UST CMT par yield — long-end anchor
series.IORB: Interest on Reserve Balances — policy rate floor

fred_real_rates.name: FRED Real-Rate / Breakeven Series (F6)
fred_real_rates.description: TIPS-implied real 10Y yield + market breakeven inflation, for the FINDING 6 nominal->real/breakeven decomposition. Written to a SEPARATE file (fred_real_rates.csv) so these scenariogen-only driver series stay out of the pricing-adjacent fred_rates.csv snapshot. Same fredgraph.csv path (no API key).

nyfed_acm.name: NY Fed ACM Term Premium (F6)
nyfed_acm.description: Adrian-Crump-Moench 10Y term premium (ACMTP10), grounding the rate_capital scenario's '10s30s steepener (term premium)' driver. Binary .xls parsed via BytesIO (trap 2).

pensford_forward_curve.name: Pensford SOFR Forward Curve
pensford_forward_curve.description: SOFR OIS par swap rates at 1Y/2Y/3Y/5Y/7Y/10Y plus projected forward path. Primary source for mid-to-long-end par nodes in SOFR OIS curve bootstrap. Updated weekly every Friday.
pensford_forward_curve.notes: Page may be JavaScript-rendered. If the scraper returns empty tables, manually download the Excel from pensford.com/forward-curve and save to data/marketdata/rates/pensford_manual.xlsx — the downloader will pick it up on the next run.

dtcc_sdr_rates.name: DTCC/CFTC SDR RATES Cumulative
dtcc_sdr_rates.description: CFTC Part-43 reportable USD interest-rate derivatives. Provides: (a) par SOFR OIS swap rates per tenor via median fixed-rate of spot-starting IRS trades; (b) cap/floor/swaption premiums + strikes for implied-vol proxy. Available from 2023-12-29.
dtcc_sdr_rates.notes: Confirmed S3 path: cftc/eod/ (not slices/). Asset Class = IR. Key filter field is UPI Underlier Name (not Underlying Asset Name which is empty). Volume (measured 2026-10-05): ~5,700 USD SOFR records/day (~4,600 NEWT), mostly cleared SEF trades — the earlier '~27 rows/day' note was an artefact of the date-keyed dedup bug (fixed in sdr-dedup: records keyed on Dissemination Identifier, every action type kept so CORR/EROR apply). lookback_business_days keeps a rolling window (records older than it are dropped) so the files stay bounded.
